candidate.blueprint_locator: Health Promotion and Maintenance — Health Promotion/Disease Prevention: provide education about health-promotion recommendations, preventive services, screenings, and age/risk-appropriate health maintenance
candidate.blueprint_topic: Health Promotion and Maintenance — adult preventive care / Medicare Annual Wellness Visit
candidate.educational_objective: Explain that the Medicare Annual Wellness Visit centers on a health risk assessment and a personalized preventive health plan rather than a routine comprehensive physical examination.

options.A: It includes a health risk assessment and develops or updates a personalized prevention plan
options.B: It is primarily a comprehensive head-to-toe diagnostic physical examination for new symptoms
options.C: It is limited to obtaining a blood pressure measurement and reviewing prescriptions
options.D: It replaces all separately recommended preventive screening services for the year

candidate.rationale: Current CMS guidance states that the Medicare Annual Wellness Visit is used to develop or update a personalized prevention plan and includes a health risk assessment. CMS distinguishes the AWV from a routine physical examination. The AWV contains multiple preventive assessment and planning components, and it does not replace other indicated Medicare-covered preventive services. Therefore A is the best answer.
candidate.source_claim_supported: The Medicare AWV includes a health risk assessment and is designed to develop or update a personalized prevention plan; it is distinct from a routine physical examination.
candidate.source_document_title: Annual Wellness Visit; Medicare Wellness Visits
candidate.source_locator: Medicare Wellness Visits > Quick Start > Annual Wellness Visit: visit to develop or update a personalized prevention plan and perform a health risk assessment; Annual Wellness Visit > First AWV Components: perform an HRA and complete personalized prevention planning/advice/referrals
